title: Input head position after a segment move
statement: Let $x$ be an input word, let a call specification and register words determine a list of segments, and let $s$ be a segment index. A track position is valid at an index when it is a boundary or a cell within that segment. Suppose $tp$ is valid at $s$, $T_2$ is valid at $G_1$, and either $G_1=s$ with the track coordinate of $T_2$ equal to that of $tp$ plus the movement $mv$, or $mv=0$ and the positions cross between the right boundary of segment $s$ and the left boundary of segment $s+1$, or between the left boundary of segment $s$ and the right boundary of segment $s-1$. If the input head position $p$ encodes track position $tp$ at segment $s$, then after moving the input head by $mv$ when $s=0$ (and by zero otherwise), its position encodes $T_2$ at segment $G_1$.
